customManagers.description: Bun catalog (workspaces.catalog + catalogs.*): Renovate only supports pnpm/yarn catalogs natively, not Bun — so capture the version strings in the root package.json via regex (RE2). currentValue must start with ^/~, which excludes the version field (0.1.4) and catalog:/workspace: refs.

packageRules.description: Catalog is the single source of truth — updates bundled into one PR instead of scattered.
udx's own config packages are unified with the CLI version (scripts/bump.sh) — do not let Renovate bump them.
